items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: He had Chu Berry, Dickie Wells and Bill Dillard. A very good stomp down band.

ctx.x: Well, Teddy Hill was -- he was a most peculiar musician in that he wasn't a very good saxophone player. He had worked earlier with Lou Russell's band. He was the tenor player in Lou Russell's band, and then when he had this band he -- he had a good band up at the Savoy. At one time he
had Chu Berry, Dickie Wells and Bill Dillard. A very good stomp down band. One thing about him, he had rehearsals regularly, you know. Sort of a regular thing, and he'd buy arrangements, you know.
I guess he had a good ear for hiring the right --

items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Was Dizzy Gillespie with Teddy Hill then? Yes. Dizzy Gillespie. Dicky Wells.

ctx.x: Was Dizzy Gillespie with Teddy Hill then?
And I guess Dizzy was sounding like Roy Eldridge.
